text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Seeking the Pearl, I spotted an open-air 
street vendor doing business.

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, take a look! Genuine Akoya 
pearls, a rare Aurora Hanadama necklace!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
This is an ultra-rare, top-tier Hanadama 
pearl! It's this huge, and right now it's 
an incredible 30% off, going for just 
100,000 yen!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
My, an Akoya pearl, you say...!? To think 
I would find one in a place like this...! 
I shall take this—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, such exquisite craftsmanship...! What 
an utterly excellent pearl design!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
My, what is it, little lady? Are you 
interested?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right, I'm absolutely 
fascinated! This sparkle, this gloss... 
Every piece of jewelry has been crafted 
with such meticulous care!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you know your stuff, young lady. Yes, 
this is an extremely rare, naturalâ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the "highest-quality imitation pearls" 
thing, right? Yeah, I totally get it!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: ! No, this is...!

"Come to think of it, Seeking the Pearl's 
father is a jeweler. If someone like her 
declares it an 'imitation', that means 
it's a fake...?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent, high-class finish. The 
texture on the surface is so fine... and 
it has such a substantial weight to it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And yet, because it's an imitation, it 
doesn't get scratched or dirty easily, 
making it great for everyday use.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... is that so? That sounds rather 
convenient, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So that people can enjoy fashion 
easily and affordably, looking every bit 
as good as the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Bravo for that spirit! A true 
champion of the common folk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Your business is fantastic! Though, it 
feels almost like a waste..."

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Ah... N-No, I... that's not...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we pitch sales that better match 
market demand?! As an ally of the common 
folk, we must pursue the potential of 
imitation goods!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
T-The possibility of imitations... The 
demand of the common folk...

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
—I see, I was wrong. Trying to rip people 
off with fakes...

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
"Ma'am! I need to correct the price on 
that necklace! That one is 1,500 yen!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! So, how about a catchphrase 
like this? 'Surprisingly affordable! 
Exquisite imitation pearl accessories that 
let anyone shine with ease!'

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sounds great, missy! With honest 
business, I'll be a champion of the common 
folk!!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
...I think I'll take this necklace after 
all. It's so pretty yet so affordable, 
I'll be able to boast about it to my 
mom-friends!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is the true charm of imitation. 
I'd love to spread this appeal even 
more... How should I promote it, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
Like a sales approach that makes the most 
of the imitation's unique traits or 
something

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... There are a lot of students 
around here, after all. I'm sure there are 
plenty of girls who want to look 
fashionable on an allowance budget!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hii, girl over there! How about some 
imitation pearl accessories? You can enjoy 
looking mature and stylish within your 
allowance budget, you know!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, pearls...? Can I really buy those 
with pocket money...?"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Waah! There are so many super cute things! 
And these earrings are only 500 yen!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"What's that, Pearl!? This bracelet is 
super cute! Totally god-tier~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's immensely popular, just as 
aimed! A pearl craze is definitely on the 
horizon!

And so, thanks in part to word of mouth 
among the students, the street vendor's 
business boomed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's true. In that case, ease of 
processing would be the priority, wouldn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I know! Let's try making a new product!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: How does this look, young lady?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Amazing! With this, it's guaranteed 
to be a blockbuster hit!

Combining Seeking the Pearl's ideas with 
the street vendor's craftsmanship, they 
created a flower-shaped bead craft made 
with imitation pearls.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Swap out the fittings and... boom, an 
unprecedented 4-way piece! It can be a 
necklace, an earring, a brooch, or even a 
keychain!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my goodness! It's wonderful, simply 
splendid! I'm buying this one too!!"

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: M-Much obliged! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Madame
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, we got so many great bargains, 
didn't we? Maybe I should let the 
neighbors know too~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like they loved it! Let's 
keep this momentum going and captivate 
more and more customers!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! How about an unprecedented 
4-way pearl!? An affordable, easy way to 
show off all kinds of style!

"—Afterward, thanks in part to 
word-of-mouth from the madam, the 4-way 
faux pearl skyrocketed in popularity, 
becoming the street vendor's signature 
item."
